title: How to Access IEEE Xplore from PICT Library
description: Step-by-step guide on logging into IEEE Xplore using your PICT institutional credentials. Learn how to search for conference papers, journals, and standards.

title: Google Scholar Search Tips & Tricks
description: Master Google Scholar with advanced search operators, citation tracking, and setting up alerts for new papers in your research area.

title: Accessing ACM Digital Library Papers
description: Complete walkthrough of the ACM Digital Library. Learn to browse proceedings, search by author, and download full-text PDFs with your institutional access.

title: Using Scopus for Literature Review
description: How to use Scopus for systematic literature reviews. Find citation metrics, h-index, and export references to citation managers.

title: arXiv: Finding Preprints for Free
description: Navigate arXiv.org to find the latest preprints in computer science, physics, and mathematics. Learn about arXiv categories and RSS feeds.

title: PubMed for Biomedical Research Papers
description: A complete guide to searching PubMed for biomedical literature. Cover MeSH terms, filters, and saving searches for later.

title: SpringerLink Access Through PICT Portal
description: Learn how to access Springer journals and e-books through the PICT library portal. Download chapters and set up reading lists.

title: Reference Management with Zotero
description: Set up Zotero for managing your research references. Import papers from IEEE, Google Scholar and generate citations automatically.
